result.summary: The page appears visually consistent with no critical issues. There is a minor layout issue with a truncated restaurant name and a minor content issue with a potentially confusing discount label.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and does not fully display.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a smaller font size, allowing multi-line text, or adjusting the card width to accommodate the full name.

issues.description: The '-100%' label on the bottom card is ambiguous. It could mean a 100% discount (free item) or something else, which might confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the label with text like 'Free delivery' or '100% off' to make the offer clear.
